sentences.text:
Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 18:00:14 +0530
 Anticipatory Bail Application No.3560 Of 2023
 Shivajee Ramkishan Gupta ...Applicant
 vs.
 The State of Maharashtra ...
Respondent

* * *
 Mr. Ravi Gupta, for the Applicant
 Ms Rashmi S. Tendulkar, App for the Respondent-State
 Mr. Rajesh Kini, Psi, Kashimira Police Station - present.

** *
 Coram : M. M. Sathaye, J.
 Dated : 24th July 2025.

P.C.: 
1. Heard learned Counsel for the Applicant and learned App for the Respondent - State.
2.

This is an Application for pre-arrest bail in connection with C.R. No. 608 of 2023 registered at Kashimira police station for the offences punishable under sections 328, 272 and 273 r/w. 34 of Indian penal Code, 1860 and sections 26(2)(i) and 26(2)(iv) of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006.
The Applicant was protected by order dated 19/12/2023.
3. The allegations pertain to contraband article - Gutakha Pan Masala, which was seized from the co-accused and who had named the present Applicant.

4. Learned APP on instructions of the officer of the concerned police station (who is present in the Court) submits that the Applicant has co- 106.ABA.3560.2023.doc operated with the investigating and charge-sheet is ready to be filed but the same is not filed due to pendency of present Application.
It is further informed that the case is already registered as SC/409/2025 with District and Sessions Court, Thane.
It is further submitted Shivajee Ramkrishan Gupta vs State Of Maharashtra on 24 July, 2025

that charge-sheet in respect of the other co-accused is already filed.

5. In the aforesaid facts and circumstances, considering the nature of allegations and further considering that the issue of application of Section 328 to gutkha is pending with Hon'ble Supreme Court and further considering that no grievance is made about co-operation by the Applicant in the investigation, case for grant of this Application is made out.
6. The Anticipatory Bail Application is allowed in terms of order dated 19/12/2023.
Applicant (Shivajee Ramkishan Gupta) is directed to attend the Trial on its commencement, unless exempted by the concerned Court.
7. Anticipatory Bail Application is disposed of in above terms.

(M. M. SATHAYE, J.)
